results.controlIntent: a. Conduct a risk assessment, including: 1. Identifying threats to and vulnerabilities in the system; 2. Determining the likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access, use, disclosure, disruption, modification, or destruction of the system, the information it processes, stores, or transmits, and any related information; and 3. Determining the likelihood and impact of adverse effects on individuals arising from the processing of personally identifiable information; b. Integrate risk assessment results and risk management decisions from the organization and mission or business process perspectives with system-level risk assessments; c. Document risk assessment results in [Selection: security and privacy plans; risk assessment report; [Assignment: organization-defined document]]; d. Review risk assessment results [Assignment: organization-defined frequency]; e. Disseminate risk assessment results to [Assignment: organization-defined personnel or roles]; and f. Update the risk assessment [Assignment: organization-defined frequency] or when there are significant changes to the system, its environment of operation, or other conditions that may impact the security or privacy state of the system.

judgment.rationale:
The only available evidence collector — getModelCard — returned null, indicating that no model card exists for "churn-predictor-v1" / "churn-predictor-endpoint". A model card is the primary artifact in this environment for documenting risk assessment results, including: (a) identified threats and vulnerabilities, (b) likelihood and magnitude of harm from unauthorized access/use/disclosure, (c) adverse effects on individuals from PII processing, (d) risk ratings, and (e) intended use and limitations. Without a model card, there is no documented evidence that any of the six RA-3 sub-requirements have been addressed:

• RA-3(a): No evidence of threat/vulnerability identification or likelihood/magnitude determinations.
• RA-3(b): No evidence of integration of organizational risk management decisions with system-level risk assessments.
• RA-3(c): No risk assessment results documented in any plan, report, or organization-defined document.
• RA-3(d): No evidence of periodic review of risk assessment results.
• RA-3(e): No evidence of dissemination of results to defined personnel or roles.
• RA-3(f): No evidence of a process to update the risk assessment on a defined frequency or upon significant changes.

The absence of a model card means the control is not satisfied.

Human attestation would be needed to confirm whether any out-of-band risk assessment documents (e.g., a separate risk assessment report, security plan, or privacy impact assessment) exist outside the model registry.
